_comment: Offline augmentation of TRAINING segments only (SRS Hint: augmented audio stays in the original's split and never counts as a unique clip). Run 'python -m sonic.augmentation build' after 'python -m sonic.preprocessing build'.
_balance: Each class is topped up with augmented copies until it has this many training segments (originals + copies), so small classes like Gunshot get more copies than Machinery Fault. Validation and test are never augmented.
_chain: Each copy applies a random chain of 2-3 transforms. Background noise is always one of them, so every class is heard over the same pool of backgrounds.

background_noise._sources: Training segments of Background Noise and Normal Machinery (MIMII factory recordings of machines working normally); never validation or test audio
background_noise._note: Mixing factory noise into every class stops 'factory hum' from meaning Machinery Fault.
